---
# Source: trailing-newlines/templates/hooks.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: hook-one-newline
  annotations:
    helm.sh/hook: pre-install
data:
  cfg: |+
    line1
    line2
